rows: every current event of a MEANINGFUL_EVENT_TYPES type with a 360 record that has a meaningful successor in the same period (event order); no time window
prediction_time: the current event: features may depend only on the current event, its own 360 snapshot and records EARLIER in the event stream (period, index); never on later events, later snapshots or labels

categories.CAUSAL_FEATURE: available at prediction time (lineage checked: current event, its snapshot, earlier records only)
categories.TARGET: the label or anything derived from the next event
categories.OFFLINE_DIAGNOSTIC: retrospective value that may use records after the current event
categories.EXCLUDED: causal but unsuitable as a model input (processing artefact)

match_id.lineage: match identifier; use for grouped splits only

current_event_index.lineage: position in the match's event stream

current_team.lineage: team name (identity; would let a model memorise teams)

actor_x.lineage: actor point of the current snapshot, CAUSAL orientation + team normalization (reference = first 360 event of the match); empty when orientation_available is false

actor_ambiguous.lineage: current snapshot has >1 distinct actor point

orientation.lineage: causal snapshot correction (processing artefact, not football state)

orientation_available.lineage: causal orientation decided; missing-indicator for actor_x/actor_y

orientation_confidence.lineage: Problem A confidence of the causal result (processing artefact)

actor_x_offline.lineage: actor position under the OFFLINE orientation (may use later records)

orientation_offline.lineage: renderer's orientation (copies in any order, period camera side, reviewer decisions, two-sided Problem A refinement)

orientation_problem_a_offline.lineage: Problem A with two-sided temporal refinement

orientation_uses_later_records.lineage: offline orientation route read later records

team_normalization.lineage: REFERENCE/MIRRORED: whether the acting team is the match's reference team (team identity)

visible_teammates.lineage: CAUSAL team identity (current + earlier records, causal orientations)

visible_ambiguous.lineage: players with unresolved team (causal); quality count, never a third team

identity_corrected_points.lineage: causal; data-quality indicator for sensitivity analyses

identity_quality.lineage: causal clean/corrected/uncertain; for masking or sensitivity analyses

visible_teammates_raw.lineage: raw teammate flags of the current snapshot (uncorrected alternative)

visible_teammates_offline.lineage: OFFLINE team identity (up to 2 s after the event)

time_to_next_event_seconds.lineage: gap to the next event (future information); diagnostic only, never used to select rows; can be 0 (simultaneous events) or negative (non-monotonic timestamps)
